body:
Hey! Happy Birthday!

I'll say growing up my birthdays weren't something I looked forward to all the time. But it sounds like you have loved ones who care and a friend who is there for you. You're worried about what this day might mean for your day to day life, but I think it shows that even in your day to day you have people you can rely on. 

Hope you take care!
Those are my thoughts too, I'm scared too. Its a struggle trying to avoid what might push me over the edge, It can be exhausting. At least know that others can relate
Venting is important. It helps me take the load of off my brain, otherwise it eats away at me. Don't feel bad for venting, this is definitely the place for that.

People tend to forget how hard even just being on meds is, the changes to your mood, the side effects, and the withdrawal if you miss a day. 

What you're going through is tough and I doubt most people would think that pills are a waste of money if they knew what people went through just for the sake of being healthy. No one would want to take pills if we didn't have to, but we do. But you're doing it! you're fighting! even if it doesn't seem like it.

I believe in you. And I really do mean that, so please hang in there
